Overview

Jinotega is a city in JI with a population of 80,000. The City of Eternal Spring, a highland city surrounded by pine forests and coffee farms. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.0.
